description: High-Performance Specs – iBELL RH26-82 Rotary Hammer Drill with 850W motor, 3J impact energy, 0–900 RPM no-load speed, 4000 BPM impact rate, 26mm SDS Plus chuck, 13mm additional chuck, 50mm spindle collar, 3.5 Kg weight, and operates on 220V~50Hz power supply. Designed for heavy-duty drilling, chiseling, and demolition in concrete, masonry, wood, and steel. Versatile Drilling Capacity – Drill up to 26mm in concrete, 68mm in masonry, 30mm in wood, and 13mm in steel. Ideal for construction, renovation, carpentry, wall installation, and civil work. Dual Chuck System – Comes with a 26mm SDS Plus chuck for secure and quick bit changes, and a 13mm additional chuck for compatibility with regular drill bits. Perfect for professionals and DIY users who need flexibility on the job. Durable & Ergonomic Design – Built with a sturdy body, soft grip handle, and balanced weight distribution (3.5 kg) for reduced fatigue during extended use. The 50mm spindle collar adds strength and drilling accuracy. Reliable and Safe Operation – Certified Class II protection, ensures user safety and long-lasting performance. Suitable for electricians, plumbers, builders, and DIY enthusiasts looking for a powerful and dependable rotary hammer drill. iBELL provides a 6 months service warranty limited to Armature and Field only. Terms and conditions apply as specified in the warranty card.
